description_en: Retrieves the staging environment deployment status of an application by application ID
description_zh: 根据应用ID获取应用测试环境部署状态
name: GetEdgeContainerStagingDeployStatus

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. You can call [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) to obtain the application ID.
<notice>AppId is required. If AppId is not specified, the API returns InvalidParameter.appid (400). You can call ListEdgeContainerApps to obtain the application ID. 
The AppId format is the prefix app- followed by 18 or more digits (at least 20 characters in total). You can obtain the actual value from the AppId field in the ListEdgeContainerApps response.
Complete call chain example: CreateEdgeContainerApp → Call ListEdgeContainerApps to obtain AppId → GetEdgeContainerStagingDeployStatus</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。
<notice>AppId 为实际必填项，未传入时 API 返回 InvalidParameter.appid(400)。可通过 ListEdgeContainerApps 获取。 
AppId 格式为 app- 前缀加 18 位以上数字（总长不少于 20 字符），可通过 ListEdgeContainerApps 的 AppId 字段获取真实值。
完整调用链示例：（CreateEdgeContainerApp → ListEdgeContainerApps 获取 AppId → GetEdgeContainerStagingDeployStatus）</notice>
parameters.name: app_id

ContainersReady.description_en:

ok: Ready.

unready: Not ready

Phase.description_en:
The status of the container in the staging environment. Valid values:
NoContainer: no container.
Pending: pending deployment.
ContainerCreating: the container is being created.
Running: running.
Succeeded: completed.
ImagePullBackOff: image pull failed.
CrashLoopBackOff: abnormal container startup.
Failed: failed.
Unknown: unknown
Phase.description_zh:
测试环境容器所处状态。
NoContainer 无容器。
Pending 等待部署。
ContainerCreating 容器创建中。
Running 运行中。
Succeeded 已完成。
ImagePullBackOff 镜像拉取失败。
CrashLoopBackOff 容器启动异常。
Failed 失败。
Unknown 未知
